name: Pacific Resources Limited
summary: Pacific Resources Limited is an Australian company dedicated to identifying and developing coal deposits. The firm holds complete ownership of two significant coal exploration licenses in Central Queensland: the Barcoo River-Blackall Rail and Blackall South Corner Coal projects. Established in 1996, the entity was previously known as AustChina Holdings Limited, officially adopting its current name, Pacific Resources Limited, in November 2025. Its main office is located in Brisbane, Australia.
